## Validation
- [ ] Static checks and tests actually executed; environment/output attached.
- [ ] Behavioral results are distinguished from static checks.
- [ ] Expectations were not weakened to obtain a pass.
- [ ] Version and changelog updated for a behavior change.
- [ ] Runtime remains instruction-only, with one policy source.
- [ ] No private data, credentials, copied corpus or invented efficacy claim.
